category_title: Low-achieving students with disruptive behaviors and high absenteeism
scenario_title: Initial philosophical inquiry and question formulation
minimal_context: The student is asked to read a fictional story about a cauldron and formulate questions in their notebook while sitting in a U-shaped arrangement.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read the story about the cauldron and write down some questions in your notebooks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Welcome to the hell. (Turns around and starts talking loudly to a friend instead of looking at the stimulus materials)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stay quiet and listen to the instructions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from the U-shaped seating arrangement) I don't want to just stay quiet and listen to you.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit back down at your place and stop disturbing your friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts walking toward the classroom door) I'm not doing this. I can get out of class anytime I feel like it.
